description: Exact crypto-address matching against the official OFAC SDN XML, up to 50 addresses. No identity data. EVM hex case normalized; other encodings case sensitive. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
